events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: A true legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of music's most iconic voices. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: A game changer
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative today as it did then.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine...
angles.copy: Forty-six years. Still hard to believe. John Lennon's message of peace and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie, a true pioneer of music and style.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years today for the one and only Elvis Presley. Still setting the standard for rock and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God turns 83
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the legendary Jimmy Page. The man behind some of rock's most unforgettable riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of the distinctive voice of Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod
angles.copy: Eighty-two today for the one and only Rod Stewart. Still rocking and still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the legendary British band Madness.

angles.name: Nutty Boy turns 66
angles.copy: Sixty-six for Suggs! The Madness frontman is still bringing the house down. What's your favourite Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful British singer Paul Young.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat...
angles.copy: Seventy-one years young for Paul Young! Still got those smooth vocals that defined an era.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The incomparable Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still working 9 to 5! Happy birthday to the living legend, Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gazza
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the man who gave us 'Back For Good' and so much more. Happy birthday, Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Celebrating the 77th birthday of the Grammy-winning British soul singer Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams...
angles.copy: Seventy-seven for Billy Ocean! The voice behind some of the biggest hits of the 80s. What's your favourite?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: A historic day for music
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock and roll got its official hall of fame. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member Mark Owen.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark!
angles.copy: Fifty-five today for Take That's Mark Owen! Still got those boyband moves.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 58 years since The Beatles performed their iconic impromptu rooftop concert on Savile Row in London in 1969.

angles.name: Get Back to the rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their final live performance on a London rooftop. Pure magic.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter and drummer, Phil Collins.

angles.name: Another day in paradise
angles.copy: Seventy-six today for the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical icon, from Genesis to solo superstardom.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Bringing Sexy Back at 46
angles.copy: Forty-six today for JT! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's still got it.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the beloved British actor Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly at 87
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today for the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, a true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering the legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years on, we remember Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives forever.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the pop icon and internet sensation, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up...
angles.copy: Sixty-one today for Rick Astley! Still got the moves and the voice that defined a generation.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae pioneer Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love at 82
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of Bob Marley. His message of 'One Love' resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the influential singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of a legend
angles.copy: Eighty-five today for the incredible Carole King. A songwriting genius and a true voice of a generation.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the iconic singer Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice, 15 years on
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and legacy live on through her timeless music.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 32 years since the original announcement of Take That's split in 1996, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, the pop world was in mourning. Take That announced their split, but thankfully, they're 'Back For Good'.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine at 68
angles.copy: Sixty-eight today for Ali Campbell! The voice of UB40, still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed!
angles.copy: Thirty-six today for Ed Sheeran! Still writing those incredible songs that capture hearts worldwide.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Here Comes The Sun, at 84
angles.copy: Eighty-four years since the birth of George Harrison. A true musical innovator and an essential part of The Beatles' magic.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Roger Daltrey, the iconic frontman of The Who.

angles.name: Hope I Die Before I Get Old...
angles.copy: Eighty-three today for Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still proving rock and roll is ageless.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the popular 80s singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good at 69
angles.copy: Sixty-nine today for Nik Kershaw! Still got those catchy tunes that defined the 80s.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman Chris Martin.

angles.name: Yellow at 50
angles.copy: Fifty years young for Coldplay's Chris Martin! A true stadium filler and songwriter.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to the legendary rock frontman Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Living on a Prayer at 65
angles.copy: Sixty-five today for the one and only Jon Bon Jovi! Still rocking stages worldwide.
